items.q: or you were telling the story of Eddie South, saying they put a screen in front of him

ctx.x: -- or you were telling the story of Eddie South, saying they put a screen in front of him so because he was playing with a white band, he wouldn't show (inaudible). That was because of it was mixed.

That's right, yeah. Well, this was the exception, it wasn't the rule. And I would go down just to be there because these were great musicians, and you know how as a youngster I wanted to be heard too. So this is why my first contact and meeting with Stuff. So when he worked with us with Nat it was just like old homecoming, and he really cooked. He was a genius, as you know. But I did some good things with Nat also.
